description: Sedimentological data from the Limpopo River Basin dams, southern Africa, 2018-2021 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. The data set contains grain size distributions, organic matter (OM) content and trace metal distribution (including Fe, Zn, Cu, Cr and Pb) of 37 shallow cores of sediments sampled from dams across the Limpopo River Basin. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are  sediments geochemistry, Houtrivier dam, Lotsane dam, Mutshedzi dam, Nwanedi dam. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
